questions.title: Which court, if any, will grant Christa Pike a stay on the day of her scheduled September 30, 2026 execution?
questions.background: Christa Pike is on Tennessee's death row for the 1995 killing of Colleen Slemmer.

Meanwhile Tennessee moved forward with its August 13 execution schedule (Anthony Darrell Hines).
